params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $objective=@'
Continue advancing Heaven Local Bridge v0.4.0 in fengie/mhw-mods. EXECUTE changes; do not merely review. Coordinate a small local swarm (implementation + security review + testing/integration). Do not use Remote Desktop Commander.

Priorities:
1. Implement credential-safe GUI input infrastructure. Secrets originate on heaven2 and must never enter the persisted GitHub relay, Git history, controller state, logs, screenshots, clipboard relay, command text, or agent transcripts. Prefer opaque secret handles, destination-local resolution, short TTL/single-use semantics, memory-only handling where feasible, redaction, allowlists, and fail-closed behavior. If a true encrypted heaven2-to-heaven channel needs new pairing material, implement the bridge-side API/resolver/tests and a clear local pairing/bootstrap path; do not fake end-to-end security.
2. Add Windows UI Automation/accessibility-tree semantic control: query/enumerate elements and stable properties; invoke/click; set value/text where supported; focus/select/toggle/expand/collapse; bounded waits. Scope selectors by process/window and fail closed on ambiguity. Keep coordinates only as fallback.
3. Expand unit/compatibility tests and live safe UIA smokes on heaven. Preserve v0.4.0 behavior; no secrets in fixtures/logs.
4. Investigate GitHub-hosted Actions runs failing before steps with runner_id=0. Fix repo-side causes if found; otherwise document the verified external blocker precisely. Local validation remains authoritative.
5. Main is canonical. Preserve concurrent work. Use temporary branches/worktrees only while active. Sync with origin/main before integration, resolve conflicts, run full gates, merge/fast-forward completed work to main, push and verify remote main, update version/docs/plugin manifest/schema if warranted, safely replace live worker, run health + GUI/UIA smokes, then delete completed task branches/worktrees. Never merge heaven-bridge queue/results runtime history into main.

Completion report: exact remote main SHA, version, features/files, secret security boundary, test counts/results, live worker PID/health, hosted Actions diagnosis, branch cleanup, and remaining concrete gaps. Continue other items if one is blocked.
'@; $bytes=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($objective); $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes); $candidates=@((Join-Path $HOME 'agent-control-panel\tools\agent-control\agentctl.mjs'),(Join-Path $HOME 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods\tools\agent-control\agentctl.mjs')); $ctl=$candidates|Where-Object{Test-Path $_}|Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $ctl){throw 'agentctl.mjs not found'}; Write-Output ('AGENTCTL='+$ctl); & node $ctl cycle --task-base64 $b64 --support 3 --priority 95; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('agentctl cycle failed exit '+$LASTEXITCODE)}
